name: Ritz-Carlton, Dubai Intl Financial Centre
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai International Financial Centre: an Art Deco-inspired city hotel in the DIFC with a direct walkway to The Gate and a Club Lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a base in the DIFC within minutes of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall
Food lovers who like a choice of restaurants and bars in one hotel

facts.text: A direct walkway leads to The Gate.
Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall and Museum of the Future are minutes away.
The hotel is described as Art Deco-inspired.
Cafe Belge pairs elegance, live entertainment, moules frites and a year-round terrace.
Club Level includes five daily culinary presentations with complimentary food and free-flow premium drinks.
The spa has two Couples Spa suites, each with its own changing room and private jacuzzi.
The Fitness Center has direct access to a heated indoor swimming pool.
Families can have an in-room Kids Tent for children.

highlights.text: Club Level guests can have camel milk smoothies in the Club Lounge.
Birch is a chef-owned restaurant led by Chef Arslan Berdiev, offering an intimate tasting-menu experience.
Mitsu-Ya offers Japanese cuisine, with a choice between an omakase chef's bar and a casual izakaya setting.
The Lobby Lounge Terrace overlooks the Porte Cochere and a 10-story waterfall.
The Hidden Room is an intimate cigar lounge with dim lighting and leather sofas.

considerations.text: Spa services and facilities are for guests 18 years of age or older.
Club access requires an upgraded booking.
WhataHotel notes the business district location may feel less resort-like.
